risk_summary: The disclosure presents strong, quantified earnings, asset, deposit, and credit-quality performance, with non-performing loans and charge-offs improving. Key risk exposure centers on management judgment in loan-loss allowances, changing economic conditions, interest rates, liquidity, real estate, and regulatory requirements.
